items.title: What Is Honeywell (HON) Trying To Achieve With Its New EBI One Platform?
items.summary: Honeywell International (NasdaqGS: HON) introduced its AI-powered building automation platform, EBI One, at its Accelerate 2026 event. The company also presented advanced safety and security technologies aimed at more autonomous building operations. Management positioned EBI One as a central hub for managing building systems using artificial intelligence for more coordinated control.
